# openmode

> Open-source video editing and rendering for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor). A CLI and MCP server that runs locally on ffmpeg: look at a video as a contact sheet with facts, render an edit file, a folder of frames or a Blender scene to MP4, and keep every version. MIT, no account, no upload, no API key.

Use openmode when a user asks an agent to edit, cut, trim, caption, combine, speed up, add music to, review or render video, or to render a Blender scene.

Install as an MCP server: `claude mcp add openmode -- npx -y openmode mcp` (Codex: `codex mcp add openmode -- npx -y openmode mcp`). Without MCP: `npx -y openmode <command>`. Requires Node 20+ and ffmpeg; Blender only for 3D scenes.

The loop: `openmode look <video>` → write an edit JSON (`openmode schema` prints the format) → `openmode render edit.json --draft` → `openmode look renders/edit-draft.mp4` → fix → `openmode render edit.json --final` → `openmode save -m "what changed"`.

## Docs

- [openmode.ai](https://openmode.ai/): install commands, a step-by-step replay of a real edit with its `look`, `render` and `versions` output and the finished video, the MCP tool list and short answers to common questions
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shansabnani/openmode/main/README.md): what it does, install commands, the loop, an example edit file, MCP tools
- [Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shansabnani/openmode/main/docs/reference.md): every edit file field, recipes, versions, library API
- [Video-editing skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shansabnani/openmode/main/skills/video-editing/SKILL.md): step-by-step instructions for agents
- [Apollo 11 example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shansabnani/openmode/main/examples/apollo-11/apollo.json): a complete edit file (clips from https URLs, speed, fades, two audio tracks, timed captions) that renders a 35-second trailer
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shansabnani/openmode/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to add an engine

## MCP tools

- look: contact sheet image + duration, size, fps, loudness (LUFS), silences, black frames, missing frames
- render_edit: edit file (clips, trims, speed, fades, captions, music, end card, loudness) → MP4; draft 360p or final up to 4K
- render_frames: folder of numbered frames + soundtrack → MP4
- render_blender: .blend file or bpy Python scene script → MP4 with the local Blender; draft (360p, few samples) or final
- versions: save, list, restore, diff for the film folder
- edit_schema: the edit format with an example
- status: check ffmpeg, Blender and features
